_comment: The signed pack catalog. The app installs nothing that is not listed here. Packs whose url contains 'PLACEHOLDER' and whose sha256 is 64 zeros have not been built or hosted yet: they are listed so the Packs screen can show them, and the app's checksum check makes every download from them fail, which is the intended safe behaviour. scripts/validate_manifest.py names every one of them. Do not hand-edit size or sha256; use scripts/update_manifest.py.

packs.name: Core
packs.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (Holdfast's own writing); underlying sources public domain
packs.attribution: Written in-house from FEMA, CDC, NOAA and American Red Cross guidance
packs.changes: Test build: draft cards and documents, not yet medically reviewed.
packs.description: Quick cards, checklists, plan vault, radio frequencies

packs.name: Medical
packs.attribution: US Public Health Service, The Ship's Medicine Chest and Medical Aid at Sea; CDC and NIOSH guides
packs.changes: First build: six public-domain US Government medical guides, 399 pages. Not yet clinician reviewed.
packs.description: First aid and medical care guides from the US Public Health Service and CDC

packs.name: WikiMed — medical encyclopedia
packs.attribution: Wikipedia contributors (WikiProject Medicine); packaged by Kiwix
packs.changes: First release: WikiMed full text, no images (Kiwix 2026-10).
packs.description: About 340,000 medical articles from Wikipedia, text only

packs.name: Water & Food
packs.attribution: CDC; EPA; USDA FSIS; USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning (via the National Center for Home Food Preservation)
packs.changes: Adds the USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning: 185 pages in all.
packs.description: Safe water, food safety after a disaster, and the USDA home canning guide

packs.name: Survival manuals

packs.description: US Army survival and field manuals, FEMA guides
